```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(circular)

# Import dataset
BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025 <- read_delim(
  "BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025.txt", delim = "\t", trim_ws = TRUE)
```



```{r}
# 3.3 Method – Nilgiri Flycatcher BirdNET Detections
# Study period: June 2024 to May 2025

# Filter Nilgiri Flycatcher detections
bird_nf <- BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025 %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2") %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(str_extract(Begin.Path, "\\d{8}"), format = "%Y%m%d"),
    Month = factor(month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
      levels = c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov",
                 "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May")),
    Time = str_extract(Begin.Path, "(?<=_)\\d{6}(?=\\.wav)"),
    Hour = as.numeric(substr(Time, 1, 2)),
    Minute = as.numeric(substr(Time, 3, 4)),
    TimeDecimal = Hour + Minute / 60,
    Season = ifelse(month(Date) %in% 3:6,
      "Breeding", "Non-breeding" ))

# Filter detections to 05:00–18:59 h
bird_daytime <- bird_nf %>% filter(!is.na(Date),
    !is.na(TimeDecimal),Hour >= 5, Hour <= 18 )

# Check filtered dataset
nrow(bird_daytime)
range(bird_daytime$Date)
table(bird_daytime$Season)
```
```{r}
# Monthly daytime NF detections

daily_nf <- bird_daytime %>% count(Date, Month, name = "NF_detections")

monthly_summary <- daily_nf %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_NF_detections = sum(NF_detections),
    Detection_days = n(),
    Mean_daily_NF = mean(NF_detections),
    SD = sd(NF_detections),
    SE = SD / sqrt(Detection_days),
    .groups = "drop")

print(monthly_summary)
```



```{r}

# Figure 4 – Mean hourly NF detections:
# Breeding (March–June) and Non-breeding (July–February)

# Hourly detections per date
hour_day <- bird_daytime %>% count(Season, Date, Hour, name = "NF_detections")

# Mean ± SE
hour_summary <- hour_day %>%
  group_by(Season, Hour) %>%
  summarise( Mean = mean(NF_detections),
    SE = sd(NF_detections) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")

print(hour_summary)

# Plot
Hourly_detections <- ggplot(
  hour_summary,
  aes(Hour, Mean, colour = Season, group = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Breeding" = "#D73027",
    "Non-breeding" = "#2C7BB6")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 5:18, limits = c(5, 18)) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hour)",
    y = "Mean daily NF detections per hour",
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13) )

print(Hourly_detections)
```



```{r}
# Figure 5 – Heat Map: Annual NF Acoustic Activity Cycle

# Daily detections per hour
hourly_daily <- bird_daytime %>%
  count(Date, Hour, name = "Detections") %>%
  tidyr::complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "day"),
    Hour = 5:18,
    fill = list(Detections = 0))

# Mean hourly detections
annual_hour_summary <- hourly_daily %>%
  group_by(Hour) %>% summarise(Mean = mean(Detections),
    SD = sd(Detections),
    .groups = "drop")

# Top line plot
p1 <- ggplot(annual_hour_summary, aes(Hour, Mean)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SD, ymax = Mean + SD),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7 ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 5:18, limits = c(5, 18)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean\nDetections") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(b = 0))

# Monthly heatmap data
month_order <- c("Jun 2024", "Jul 2024", "Aug 2024", "Sep 2024",
  "Oct 2024", "Nov 2024", "Dec 2024", "Jan 2025",
  "Feb 2025", "Mar 2025", "Apr 2025", "May 2025")

heat_data <- hourly_daily %>%
  mutate(Month = format(Date, "%b %Y")) %>%
  group_by(Month, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanDetections = mean(Detections),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Month = month_order,
    Hour = 5:18,
    fill = list(MeanDetections = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_order))

# Heatmap
p2 <- ggplot(heat_data, aes(Hour, Month, fill = MeanDetections)) +
  geom_tile( colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5,
    width = 0.98, height = 0.98 ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 5:18, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE, expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7", high = "#08519c",
    name = "Mean\nDetections") +
  labs(x = "Hour of day", y = "Month") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank())

# Combine plots
Heat_map <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p1, p2, ncol = 1, align = "v",
  axis = "lr", rel_heights = c(1, 4))

print(Heat_map)
```



```{r}
# 3.3 Method – Circular Statistics: Annual and Diel Activity

# Study period
study_start <- as.Date("2024-06-01")
study_end <- as.Date("2025-05-31")

# Use daytime detections only
bird <- bird_daytime %>% filter(Date >= study_start, Date <= study_end)

# ANNUAL CIRCULAR STATISTICS

daily_counts <- bird %>%
  count(Date, name = "Detections") %>%
  mutate(StudyDay = as.numeric(Date - study_start) + 1)

annual_angles <- circular(
  rep(2 * pi * daily_counts$StudyDay / 365,
    daily_counts$Detections),
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi")

mean.circular(annual_angles)
rho.circular(annual_angles)
sd.circular(annual_angles)
rayleigh.test(annual_angles)


# DIEL CIRCULAR STATISTICS

hourly_counts <- bird %>%
  count(Hour, name = "Detections")
diel_angles <- circular(
  rep(2 * pi * (hourly_counts$Hour - 5) / 14,
    hourly_counts$Detections ),
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi")

mean.circular(diel_angles)
rho.circular(diel_angles)
sd.circular(diel_angles)
rayleigh.test(diel_angles)
```

```{r}
# 3.2 Results - Sex-specific BirdNET Classifier Evaluation (G drive 04)

# Directories and parameters
manual_sex_files <- choose.files("Select manual annotation files",multi = TRUE)
birdnet_sex_files <- choose.files("Select BirdNET annotation files",multi = TRUE)
minimum_overlap <- 0.5
thresholds <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)
classes <- c("Female", "Male")


# clean manual annotations
manual_sex_clean <- map_dfr(manual_sex_files, read.delim) %>%
  mutate(Audiofile = str_to_lower(basename(gsub("\\\\+", "/", Begin.Path))),
    Sex = str_to_title(trimws(Species.Code)),
    Begin = as.numeric(Begin.Time..s.),
    End = as.numeric(End.Time..s.)) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% classes, !is.na(Begin), !is.na(End), End > Begin)


# clean BirdNET predictions
birdnet_sex_clean <- map_dfr(birdnet_sex_files, read.delim) %>%
  mutate(
    Audiofile = str_to_lower(basename(gsub("\\\\+", "/", Begin.Path))),
    Sex = str_to_title(trimws(Species.Code)),
    Begin = as.numeric(Begin.Time..s.),
    End = as.numeric(End.Time..s.),
    Confidence = as.numeric(Confidence)) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% classes, !is.na(Begin), !is.na(End),
    End > Begin, !is.na(Confidence) )


# Match manual songs with BirdNET detections
match_events_sex <- function(threshold, sex) {
  manual <- manual_sex_clean %>%
    filter(Sex == sex) %>%
    mutate(Manual_ID = row_number())
  predictions <- birdnet_sex_clean %>%
    filter(Sex == sex, Confidence >= threshold) %>%
    mutate(Prediction_ID = row_number())
  
  # Match manual songs with BirdNET detections
  matches <- inner_join(
    manual, predictions, by = "Audiofile",
    suffix = c("_manual", "_birdnet")) %>%
    mutate(Overlap = pmin(End_manual, End_birdnet) -
        pmax(Begin_manual, Begin_birdnet)) %>%
    filter(Overlap >= minimum_overlap)
  
  # Count each manual song only once
  matched_manual <- unique(matches$Manual_ID)
  
  # Identify BirdNET predictions associated with manual songs
  matched_predictions <- unique(matches$Prediction_ID)
  
  TP <- length(matched_manual)
  FN <- nrow(manual) - TP
  FP <- nrow(predictions) - length(matched_predictions)
  
  Precision <- if (TP + FP > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA
  Recall <- if (TP + FN > 0) TP / (TP + FN) else NA
  F1 <- if (!is.na(Precision) && !is.na(Recall) &&
            Precision + Recall > 0) {
    2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall) } else NA
  data.frame(Threshold = threshold, Sex = sex, TP, FP, FN,
             Precision, Recall, F1)}


# Calculate metrics for each threshold
results_sex <- map_dfr(thresholds, function(th) {
  sex_results <- map_dfr(
    classes, ~ match_events_sex(th, .x) )
  overall <- sex_results %>%
    summarise(Threshold = th,
      Sex = "Overall",
      TP = sum(TP),
      FP = sum(FP),
      FN = sum(FN)) %>%
    mutate( Precision = ifelse(TP + FP > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA),
      Recall = ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA),
      F1 = ifelse(Precision + Recall > 0,
        2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall), NA))
  bind_rows(sex_results, overall)})


# Results table
Sex_Specific_table <- results_sex %>%
  select(Threshold, Sex, Precision, Recall, F1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sex,
    values_from = c(Precision, Recall, F1),
    names_glue = "{Sex}_{.value}" ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
print(Sex_Specific_table)
```





```{r}
# 3.2 Results - Default BirdNET Classifier Evaluation (G drive 03)

# Directories and parameters
manual_files <- choose.files("Select manual annotation files",multi = TRUE)
birdnet_files <- choose.files("Select BirdNET annotation files",multi = TRUE)
minimum_overlap <- 0.5
thresholds <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)


# Import and clean manual annotations
manual_clean <- map_dfr(manual_files, read.delim) %>%
  mutate(
    Audiofile = str_to_lower(basename(Begin.Path)),
    Begin = as.numeric(Begin.Time..s.),
    End = as.numeric(End.Time..s.),
    Species = trimws(as.character(Species.Code))) %>%
  filter( str_to_lower(Species) == "nilfly2",
    !is.na(Begin), !is.na(End), End > Begin )


# Import and clean BirdNET predictions
birdnet_clean <- map_dfr(birdnet_files, read.delim) %>%
  mutate(
    Audiofile = str_to_lower(basename(Begin.Path)),
    Begin = as.numeric(Begin.Time..s.),
    End = as.numeric(End.Time..s.),
    Confidence = as.numeric(Confidence),
    Species = trimws(as.character(Common.Name)) ) %>% filter(
    str_to_lower(Species) == "nilgiri flycatcher",
    !is.na(Begin), !is.na(End), End > Begin,
    !is.na(Confidence) )


# Match manual songs with BirdNET detections
match_events <- function(threshold) {
  manual <- manual_clean %>%
    mutate(Manual_ID = row_number())
  predictions <- birdnet_clean %>%
    filter(Confidence >= threshold) %>%
    mutate(Prediction_ID = row_number())
  matches <- inner_join(
    manual, predictions, by = "Audiofile",
    suffix = c("_manual", "_birdnet")) %>%
  mutate(Overlap = pmin(End_manual, End_birdnet) -
        pmax(Begin_manual, Begin_birdnet)) %>%
    filter(Overlap >= minimum_overlap) %>%
    arrange(desc(Overlap))
  
  # Assign each prediction to only one manual song
  assigned <- matches %>%
    group_by(Audiofile, Prediction_ID) %>%
    slice_max(Overlap, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
  
  # Count each manual song only once
  matched_manual <- unique(assigned$Manual_ID)
  matched_predictions <- unique(assigned$Prediction_ID)
  
  TP <- length(matched_manual)
  FN <- nrow(manual) - TP
  FP <- nrow(predictions) - length(matched_predictions)
  
  Precision <- if (TP + FP > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA
  Recall <- if (TP + FN > 0) TP / (TP + FN) else NA
  F1 <- if (!is.na(Precision) && !is.na(Recall) &&
            Precision + Recall > 0) {2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall)} else NA
  data.frame(Threshold = threshold, TP, FP, FN,
    Precision, Recall, F1 )}

# Calculate metrics for each threshold
results <- map_dfr(thresholds, match_events)

# Final results table
Species_Specific_table <- results %>% select(Threshold, Precision, Recall, F1) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
print(Species_Specific_table)
```





```{r}
# Overall manual vs BirdNET detection summary

manual_summary <- manual_clean %>% mutate(Manual_ID = row_number())
birdnet_summary <- birdnet_clean %>% mutate(Prediction_ID = row_number())

# Match detections based on temporal overlap
matched_events <- inner_join(
  manual_summary, birdnet_summary,
  by = "Audiofile",
  suffix = c("_manual", "_birdnet")) %>%
  mutate( Overlap = pmin(End_manual, End_birdnet) -
      pmax(Begin_manual, Begin_birdnet)
  ) %>% filter(Overlap >= minimum_overlap) %>%
  arrange(desc(Overlap))

# Assign each BirdNET prediction to only one manual song
assigned <- matched_events %>%
  group_by(Prediction_ID) %>%
  slice_max(Overlap, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Count each manual song only once
Detected <- n_distinct(assigned$Manual_ID)

Total_Manual <- nrow(manual_summary)
Total_BirdNET <- nrow(birdnet_summary)
Missed <- Total_Manual - Detected

Default_BirdNET_Summary <- data.frame(
  Total_Manual,
  Total_BirdNET,
  Detected,
  Missed,
  Detection_Rate = round(Detected / Total_Manual * 100, 2))
print(Default_BirdNET_Summary)
```





```{r}
# Monthly data
monthly_results <- manual_summary %>%
  mutate( Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(Audiofile, "\\d{8}"),
      format = "%Y%m%d"),
    Detected = Manual_ID %in% unique(assigned$Manual_ID)
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
  mutate( Month = as.Date(format(Date, "%Y-%m-01"))
  ) %>% group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise( Total_Manual_Songs = n(),
    Detected_Songs = sum(Detected), .groups = "drop")


# Plotting
bar_data <- monthly_results %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(format(Month, "%B"),
      levels = c("March", "April", "May", "October", "November", "December") ) ) %>%
  arrange(Month) %>% select(Month,
    Actual_Songs = Total_Manual_Songs,
    BirdNET_Detected = Detected_Songs )

bar_long <- bar_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Actual_Songs, BirdNET_Detected),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Songs") %>%
  mutate(Category = recode(Category,
      Actual_Songs = "Actual Number of Songs",
      BirdNET_Detected = "Songs Detected by BirdNET"))


# Bar graph
Bar_Plot <- ggplot(bar_long, aes(x = Month, y = Songs, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3 ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Actual Number of Songs" = "#A8D5BA",
    "Songs Detected by BirdNET" = "#A7C7E7" )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 900),
    breaks = seq(0, 900, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)) ) +
  labs(title = "Actual Number of Songs vs Songs Detected by BirdNET",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Songs",
    fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme( plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
print(Bar_Plot)
```
